question: what was the percent of the increase in the backlog from 2012 to 2013
reasoning: We need to find backlog for 2012 and 2013. From document: Backlog at December 31, 2014 was $80.5 billion, 2013 $82.6 billion, 2012 $82.3 billion? Actually in Item 6 Selected Financial Data: Backlog: 2014 $80,547, 2013 $82,600, 2012 $82,300. Also in MD&A: "Backlog was approximately $80.5 billion, $82.6 billion and $82.3 billion at December 31, 2014, 2013 and 2012." So 2012 = 82.3, 2013 = 82.6. Increase = 0.3 billion. Percent increase = (82.6-82.3)/82.3 *100 = 0.3/82.3 *100 ≈ 0.3645%. So answer ~0.36%.
